items.name: Ontario refinery black mass recycling plant-scale trial
items.claim: Electra Battery Materials processed 40 tonnes of black mass material in a plant-scale setting at its Ontario refinery complex, believed to be the first of its kind in North America.
items.source_excerpt: Electra has processed 40 tonnes of black mass material in a plant scale setting, believed to be the first of its kind in North America.

notes: Stored 6-K (0001171843-26-005869) carries only a passing mention of black-mass recycling with no quantified figure. A dedicated electrabmc.com news release (2024-02-05, stored HTTP 200) supplies the one quantified processing-volume disclosure used above; currency left null since the value is a tonnage, not a monetary figure. No newer, dated black-mass volume disclosure is stored.

changelog.change: run pipeline: initial write from stored web evidence (electrabmc.com black mass recycling update, 2024-02-05)
